name: GhostToastProvider
description: Renderless owner of one provider-scoped toast store (no module-global queue). Descendants publish with useGhostToast(); a descendant GhostToastViewport renders the stack. At most `limit` toasts are visible and later ones wait in FIFO order. Informational toasts auto-dismiss after `duration` ms (8000 by default); error and action toasts persist. During SSR toast() is a no-op with a development warning; on the client, toasts created before the viewport mounts wait and are shown when it mounts. Unmounting the provider dismisses every toast and calls each onDismiss once.

props.name: duration
props.description: Default auto-dismiss interval in ms for informational toasts. `0` persists.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the viewport region.

props.name: limit
props.description: Maximum number of visible toasts; later toasts wait in FIFO order.
